verdicts.reason: Both use the same layout. The cream card swells to fill almost the whole canvas and sits on the top and bottom edges, so the terrazzo confetti that defined the original shrinks to a thin edge strip. The '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' eyebrow is moved from above the headline to the bottom-left, made large and wrapped with 'READERS' orphaned on its own line, which breaks the reading order. The fine print next to the CTA is too small to read. A is very slightly better because it keeps a bit more confetti at the edges and its fine print wraps less badly. B pushes the card nearly to the edge on every side and squeezes the legal text into a 4-line sliver.
